title: Accused of ‘emptying the coffers’, Macron mulls spending caps for future French governments
summary: Right-wing candidates vying to succeed French President Emmanuel Macron have welcomed his suggestion of a “golden rule” to cap government spending and keep deficits in check, even as they mock the profligacy of his decade in power. Critics of the proposal denounce a budgetary straitjacket imposed on future governments and a distraction from the president’s…
